mapper.select: select count(1) from fin_fund_log where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: insert into fin_fund_log( account_id, biz_type, bill_id, bill_no, direction, change_amount, before_balance, after_balance, biz_date, counterparty_name, remark, create_by, create_time ) values( #{accountId}, #{bizType}, #{billId}, #{billNo}, #{direction}, #{changeAmount}, #{beforeBalance}, #{afterBalance}, #{bizDate}, #{counterpartyName}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

mapper.insert: insert into fin_fund_transfer( transfer_no, out_account_id, in_account_id, amount, fee_amount, transfer_date, status, audit_by, audit_time, remark, create_by, create_time ) values( #{transferNo}, #{outAccountId}, #{inAccountId}, #{amount}, coalesce(#{feeAmount}, 0), #{transferDate}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update fin_fund_transfer
status = #{status},
audit_by = null, audit_time = null,

remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(),
